models.name: Seedance 2.0

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image for image-to-video generation (start frame).

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Set to -1 for intelligent duration (model picks the best length).

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Set to 'adaptive' to let the model choose the best ratio based on inputs.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Generate audio synchronized with the video. When enabled, the model outputs a video with native audio including dialogue, sound effects, and ambient sounds.

last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_image.description: Input image for last frame generation. Only works if an image start frame is also provided.

reference_audios.title: Reference Audios
reference_audios.description: Reference audio files (up to 3, max 15s each) for audio-visual synchronization, lip-sync, and beat matching.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Reference images (up to 9) for character consistency, style guidance, and scene composition. Cannot be used together with first frame or last frame images.

reference_videos.title: Reference Videos
reference_videos.description: Reference videos (up to 3, max 15s each) for motion transfer, camera movement guidance, and style reference.

models.costPerImage: For every second of 720p video you generated, you will be charged $0.2419/second. Your request will cost $0.0112 per 1000 tokens. The number of tokens is given by (height of output video * width of output video * duration * 24) / 1024.
